exclusions: one cohort member removed at a time (all 23 left and 57 right members), plus a full-cohort control per seed/heading/placement
primary: paired directional-vs-neutral wins/ties/losses and collected totals per excluded node, compared against the full-cohort control
limits: Fresh seeds 201-204 fixed before execution; 16 correlated rotations/placements per seed. Removing a node changes both the rotating subset and RNG-to-node identity; k stays 22 and attempts stay matched, but closed-loop effective current is not claimed equal. Descriptive attribution only; no significance claim and no node is promoted or condemned on this evidence alone.
